goal: Build and document a source-faithful interactive Three.js folding OSG portfolio device for the 1920x1080 desktop frame.
progress_summary: Rebuilt the enclosure, hinge, controls, SVG marks, materials, typography, CSS3D UI, and interaction model from the supplied Figma/SVG dimensions. Recorded all user corrections and verified the finished desktop behavior in the live browser.
implemented_features: Continuous articulated 170-degree hinge with exact 95/610/95 source envelopes
Upper and lower shell thicknesses and 4px/16px/2px radius rules
Recessed speakers and upper display surround, glossy ABS, chrome badge, optical camera lens
Supplied SVG geometry for placeholder, inner badge, and source-derived lid engraving
OSG Capsules 300/400/700 with cap-height-aware 17px and 11px UV label rasterization
Exact capsule buttons, D-pad silhouette and arrows, motion toggle, theme control, ports, and LEDs
Square active displays with Lisse-smoothed rounded UI elements
Physical press-and-return motion without scale changes
Wheel, vertical keyboard, vertical D-pad, right-button, toggle, theme, and hinge interactions
No ground or contact shadow; desktop-only 1920x1080 composition

verification.tests: bun test: 6 pass, 0 fail, 30 expect calls
verification.production_build: bun run build: pass; only the existing Vite 500 kB chunk advisory remains
verification.browser_console: 0 entries after hinge, physical control, wheel, keyboard, toggle, and theme scenarios
verification.browser_interactions: wheel 4->5->4; keyboard horizontal unchanged and vertical changes; D-pad horizontal unchanged and vertical changes; right buttons 0/1/2; theme and motion pass
verification.visual_diff: 1920x1080 dimensions match; 69/100 against the flat source raster, with expected PBR/depth differences
